correctness.rationale: The inspected proof fixes the inner product linear in its first variable and correctly transforms conjugate-linear coefficient matrices by unitary congruence. Splitting unitary M into symmetric S and skew K gives K* K=b²I, and a Cayley–Hamilton SU(2) identity yields S* S=a²I. Takagi congruence gives canonical real M=[[a,b],[-b,a]], including a=0. For a unit x the self-overlap modulus fills m∈[0,a]. Each allowed y=qbar x+s exp(i phi)v, and ||Ax||=c, so the possible |<Ax,y>| at fixed x are exactly [|tm−s sqrt(c²−m²)|,tm+s sqrt(c²−m²)]. Connectedness and simultaneous phase rotation fill every annular radius/argument; maximizing and minimizing over m give the claimed piecewise sharp formulas. Check pure symmetric a=c/b=0, pure skew a=0/b=c, q=0 and |q|=1 explicitly. Inspected check.py Gram constraints and extremizers, but these finite examples are supplemental.
